preparation.history_rule: strictly earlier timestamps; standard long_view=1 only; no random feedback
preparation.feedback_assumption: prior event feedback available before next event; overlap diagnostic is not availability proof

selection.criterion: Mean development GAUC; prefer simpler model when paired user interval includes zero
